common_sample.proxy_quotes: include and report source and proxy flag

market_reference.interpretation: probability reference only; never an execution price

forecast_models.C: L2 logistic regression with intercept on logit(p_market)
forecast_models.D: L2 logistic regression with intercept on logit(p_market) and logit(existing calibrated p_BTC)

folds.reason: no earlier development book-labelled sample for fitting C or D

chronological_cv.estimator: sklearn LogisticRegression(penalty=l2, solver=lbfgs, fit_intercept=true, class_weight=null, max_iter=2000)
chronological_cv.selection_metric: lowest pooled chronological out-of-fold log loss across eligible folds; exact ties prefer lower C (stronger regularization)

probability_metrics.calibration_bin_edges: forecast-specific deciles fitted on development chronological out-of-fold predictions; reused unchanged on holdout

paired_holdout_uncertainty.bootstrap: paired moving 3-day UTC blocks, 1000 replicates, seed 20261012

independent_order_economics.execution_rule: same T-60 side and requested amount; ask-side fee-adjusted FAK fill from actual T-59 snapshot, preserving current minimum, partial-fill, depth and proxy rules

final_portfolio_selection.development_predictions: chronological out-of-fold rows from the same eligible folds used for C/D selection; A and B scored on those identical rows
final_portfolio_selection.sizing: 5% of free cash at T-60, no additional cap
final_portfolio_selection.candidates: A, B, C and D crossed with every frozen EV threshold, plus no-trade
final_portfolio_selection.selection_metric: highest final settled cash; ties prefer lower max drawdown, fewer trades, then no-trade

limitations: Historical holdout has been viewed before this experiment; results are diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
Valid paired T-60 quotes begin on 2026-04-15; no earlier missing quotes are imputed.
Only two eligible chronological validation folds are available for selecting C/D regularization.
